items.title: The Loud House Movie
items.synopsis: The Loud family travel to Scotland and discover they are descendants of Scottish royalty as they move into their giant ancestral castle.

items.title: Phony
items.synopsis: After waking up from a freak car accident, Sonny discovers that his mother has been replaced by an impostor.

items.title: The Golden Life
items.synopsis: Bound by decades of shared history, fallouts and friendship, this fan-favorite group of New Yorkers are starting fresh together in the Sunshine State. In this new ‘golden’ era of life, the longtime friends are thriving in and around Palm Beach with fabulous second homes and a bustling social scene. With their signature humor and non-stop hijinks, the group navigates dating, family, and career milestones. Though skies are bright in Florida, unresolved drama looms as they reconnect after years of highs and lows.

items.title: Vanderpump Rules: Lisa Las Vegas
items.synopsis: Follow Lisa Vanderpump as she opens The Vanderpump Hotel (formerly The Cromwell) on the Las Vegas Strip in partnership with Caesars Entertainment

items.title: Only Fools And Horses: The Lost Archive
items.original_title: Only Fools And Horses: The Lost Archive
items.synopsis: Two-part documentary revealing previously unseen footage from the hit sitcom. Features David Jason, Tessa Peake-Jones, Gwyneth Strong, Sue Holderness, Steven Woodcock and more.

items.title: SOR
items.synopsis: In the series *SOR*, every patient represents a unique story, and successive shifts demonstrate that no two cases in the ER are alike. Patients admitted to the hospital will include, for instance, a critically injured motorcyclist whose condition fails to improve despite standard procedures; doctors and paramedics will also fight to save the life of a well-known TV presenter, while teenagers involved in a serious electric scooter accident will also arrive at the unit. A major test for the entire team will be a bus crash that places the ER on high alert. A large number of critically injured patients will arrive simultaneously, forcing doctors to make split-second decisions on which lives depend.

items.title: Wicker
items.synopsis: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

items.title: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
items.synopsis: In this modern reimagining of the infamous study, 30 people enter a real prison for two weeks and shifting power dynamics expose what they're capable of.

items.title: Just One Before I Die
items.synopsis: Chronicles the unwavering spirit of Buffalo Bills' die-hard fans, affectionately known as "Bills Mafia," as they navigate heartbreaks and hopes in their quest for an elusive championship.

items.title: Apsara
items.synopsis: Braving modern-day evils, power-blessed Sunheri is the sole protector of her celestial clan! But her blood sister Dhara stands in her way! Can she fight her?

items.title: Klara and the Sun
items.synopsis: An Artificial Friend named Klara finds a deep bond with a troubled young girl, bringing light and hope to a grieving family through her unwavering devotion and innocent wonder.

items.title: Coward
items.synopsis: Pierre, a young Belgian soldier, wants to prove himself on the battlefield during the First World War. Behind the frontlines, he meets Francis, who is asked to find a way to boost morale.

items.title: Small Town Remedy
items.synopsis: After losing his job at a top-tier hospital due to an unexpected incident, Liu Zhengliang returns to his hometown and begins working in the emergency department of a local community hospital. While healing patients one after another, he finds himself continually healed by their resilience and humanity, creating a mutual journey of recovery and growth between caregiver and those in need.

items.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
items.synopsis: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

items.title: Green Grass
items.synopsis: It's no secret that Declan is the university class coaster, which is why his friends refuse to partner with him on their next assignment. Out of options, Declan is forced to pair up with Claire, the new Deaf student who is everything Declan isn't; academic, driven and fiercely proud of her identity. Set against the backdrop of coastal university life on the south coast of England, Green Grass dips into the murky waters of strained friendships, sustainability, and D/deaf identity in this coming-of-age drama.

items.title: Swipe Right on the Devil
items.synopsis: Revisits the 2017 murder of 24-year-old Sydney Loofe, who disappeared and was later found dead after going on a Tinder date with Bailey Boswell.

items.title: Couldn't Agree Less with Allison & Isaac
items.original_title: Couldn't Agree Less with Allison & Isaac
items.synopsis: Real-life couple Allison Kuch and Isaac Rochell invite viewers into their messiest, most honest disagreements — tackling everything from money and parenting to jealousy and in-laws through audience submissions, guest perspectives, and pop culture debates.

items.title: Chaar Yaar
items.synopsis: A story of four middle-class boys, their dreams, setbacks and friendship being their armour. A fateful decision leads them to take a step that changes the course of their lives trapping them between gangsters and cops. What once held them together slowly tears their bond. With their armour shattered, their enemies close in and fate serves up a bill for their crimes.

items.title: It Gets Worse
items.synopsis: Three best friends from college face eviction in London. As they scatter across the city, they navigate friendship, dating disasters, and adulting - all while the world crumbles around them.

items.title: Verônica com K
items.synopsis: The plot follows a Black lawyer and favela resident who gets involved with organized crime.

items.title: Did Someone Happen to Mention Me?
items.original_title: 俺のこと、なんか言ってた？
items.synopsis: Gen Takasegawa, the first Japanese actor to play the lead role at London's Shakespeare’s Globe Theatre, has been unable to return to Japan for some time. After two years, he finally makes his way back home, only to find out that he is suddenly and completely forgotten by the entire world.

items.title: A Talent for Murder
items.synopsis: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

items.title: Newlyweds
items.synopsis: A mature romance about a free-spirited woman and a reserved professor who marry quickly after a brief, passionate courtship.

items.title: Udta Teer
items.synopsis: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

items.title: Tu Hai Meri Kiran
items.synopsis: When love becomes an obsession, the line between devotion and danger begins to blur.

items.title: Gajab Raat
items.synopsis: A corrupt, troubled cop's night spirals out of control when a reluctant act of mercy toward an injured girl pulls him into a deadly web of crime.

items.title: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
items.synopsis: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

items.title: Little Thomas
items.synopsis: In early 1990s Goa, seven year old Thomas and his family navigate thr ups and downs in their lives.

items.title: Doosra
items.synopsis: The 2002 NatWest Final was more than a cricketing victory for India. It was a moment when a nation found its voice, and a young girl found the courage to speak her truth.

items.title: Dhood (Sandstorm)
items.synopsis: Set against the vast expanse of the Thar desert, an isolated family's desperate wishes and psychological friction trigger a dark domestic countdown, threatening to reduce their household entirely into dust

items.title: YAGA
items.synopsis: While a private investigator probes the disappearance of the young heir to a powerful fishery, he finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.

items.title: R91
items.synopsis: The aircraft carrier *Charles de Gaulle* has just set sail for a strategic mission in the Eastern Mediterranean, a region where the situation is volatile. Shortly after departure, however, a female crew member is found dead and another is reported missing. Despite the danger, the operation continues, and a military investigator is urgently dispatched on board. When a new victim is discovered, the *Charles*—a veritable floating city of 1,800 men and 240 women—turns into a trap where a killer, mounting tensions, and unfolding events threaten the crew and perhaps even the country itself.

items.title: Shadows of the Ten Ninja
items.original_title: 真田十勇士 SHADOWS OF THE TEN NINJA
items.synopsis: Fourteen years after the Battle of Sekigahara, imprisoned warrior Sanada Yukimura joins forces with the exceptionally skilled ninja Sasuke Sarutobi and nine other warriors to escape confinement and protect the Toyotomi family from Ieyasu Tokugawa’s ambition. As the Sanada Ten Braves head toward the Siege of Osaka, they face betrayals, rivalries, and dangerous schemes while forging unbreakable bonds and challenging the powerful Tokugawa regime.

items.title: The Sound of Sugar Cubes
items.synopsis: A high school boy who can hear the emotions and memories of others through sound tries to hide his unusual ability from the world. His encounter with a seemingly perfect idol trainee forces him to confront feelings he has long suppressed. As love, obsession, and emotional wounds intertwine, their relationship reveals the fragile boundary between salvation and destruction.

items.title: Tigers Sniff the Rose
items.synopsis: Tells the story of Mu Wanyao, a noble daughter unwilling to accept her fate, and Yan Shang, a brilliant young man from a humble background. Together, they fight to build a peaceful world. Amidst the chaos of a troubled era, can their dreams come true?

items.title: Mary
items.synopsis: A woman has a spirit haunting her upon leaving her church.

items.title: Four Corners
items.synopsis: Alba, aged 14, is entering her early teenage years. Through her interactions with several of her classmates, she will begin to understand and see the world in a different light.

items.title: The Netherlands' Dumbest
items.synopsis: The Netherlands' Dumbest a humorous quiz show, as this version will be titled ten Dutch celebrities compete under the guidance of hosts Edson da Graça and Monica Geuze. Their goal? To get sent home as quickly as possible, ensuring they aren’t crowned the winner of the program. Along the way, however, they must rack their brains over a variety of academic style questions, logic puzzles, physical challenges, and other tests. But there’s a twist.

items.title: Oh! My Guard
items.synopsis: A wildly unpredictable romance begins when a flawed “master of melodrama” actor encounters a mysterious woman who believes she is the female lead of a TV drama.

items.title: Final Table
items.synopsis: The Table: K-Chef 2026 brings together Korea's top chefs to compete for the title of the country's best chef. Mysterious world-renowned chef Chris K., also known as Kang Han, Song-yi, who is fighting to save her restaurant, perfectionist star chef Woo-jin, and chefs with stories of their own face off in a fierce culinary battle. More than a competition, they find comfort in food and one another.

items.title: Minimum Wage
items.synopsis: Teens struggle to run a local pizzeria while juggling school, a manic boss and minimum wage.

items.title: The Mob
items.synopsis: Celebrities compete in mob-themed challenges at an Italian villa for $250,000. They elect a don who controls eliminations and prize money. As power demands loyalty, contestants must decide whether to support the don or overthrow them.

items.title: Blue Flower, Forest of Vessels
items.synopsis: Born and raised in Hasami, Aoko works as a porcelain painter, taking pride in the quiet rhythm of her craft and the town’s long tradition of pottery. When a solitary ceramic artist from Finland arrives and dismisses painted decoration, Aoko is initially offended, but as she discovers the beauty of his work, she finds herself increasingly drawn to both his art and the man behind it.

items.title: Summer Vacation
items.synopsis: An ordinary teen girl longs for something new – will meeting a handsome boy in a countryside village change her life?

items.title: Hotel Utopia
items.synopsis: In an abandoned hotel deep in the Bulgarian mountains, digital nomads search for a new home, investors are hoping for profit, and the last villager revels in days gone by – all driven by the longing for #happyland in a place shaped by a socialist past.

items.title: The One About Matthew Perry
items.synopsis: Told through intimate testimonies from close family and friends, this documentary event reveals the real Matthew Perry—generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life—and the battles he fought to become the man behind the icon. A raw record of a life lived in full, and the honesty that became his greatest legacy.

items.title: Look, We're in Europe
items.synopsis: Building houses far from home: through their own mobile phone images, Bangladeshi construction workers in Kosovo offer a raw glimpse of life between precarious work and dreams of a bett er future.

items.title: Breeder
items.synopsis: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

items.title: Drive - The Pretenders
items.synopsis: A young race car mechanic fakes an engagement to the most scandalous racing star on the scene—officially for his reputation, secretly for her own chance behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything, including what has long since become more than just a game.

items.title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
items.original_title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
items.synopsis: A powerful return to roots, this concert captures Black Sabbath in peak form - reuniting to deliver classic hits with raw energy and legendary precision.

items.title: The Mongoose
items.synopsis: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

items.title: Nocturne
items.synopsis: When a victim of notorious serial killer Jurek Walter unexpectedly turns up alive, detective Jonah Lynn races against time to find the one person still missing, while his protégé Saga Bauer goes undercover to get answers from the killer himself.

items.title: Tenfa
items.synopsis: In the remote Himalayan village of Kandar, a midwife faces a life-threatening childbirth with no medical recourse. Her only hope lies in finding a wild herb known to heal such cases. The lone person who can identify this herb is an elderly grandmother, living with her teenage granddaughter. So as the three women journey in search - across lands scarred by hydropower projects, they uncover the erosion of both ecology and memory. When an old Kinnauri folksong becomes their guide, tradition and technology converge to revive a fading language, a disappearing landscape, and deep kinship between their people and the earth.

items.title: Stray Girls
items.synopsis: A story from a working-class neighborhood in New Delhi, about a girl’s rebellion and it taking an unexpected magical turn.

items.title: The Ordinary Star
items.synopsis: Actor Nawazuddin Siddiqui is asked to study Ashok, the actual resident of the room the actor is going to inhabit for the filming of Star, Dibakar Banerjee’s short in Bombay Talkies, 2013. The fiction director, the documentary filmmakers and the actor, bit by bit, construct the lead character of Bombay Talkies, Porandar Vithal. Ashok feeds this construction through his own life. The Ordinary Star is a documentary that ponders over the nature and cost of the cinematic process, it’s invasiveness, it’s need to devour so that it can create, and the endless search to live a life less ordinary.

items.title: Hudke Ki Pyaang Pyaang
items.synopsis: In a small Himalayan town, Vikas and Jyoti, a Dalit boy and a Brahmin girl plan an escape to the city through government teaching jobs. When paying the required bribe demands selling his ailing father’s ancestral shop, Vikas hesitates, causing their relationship to crack.

items.title: Accounts of a Killing
items.synopsis: The film is a collection of testimonies about how people remember the death of a young man in the town of Khuldabad in the Deccan. Through these memories of a death, each different from the other, the film attempts to sketch a portrait of the town, its people and the contested times we live in.

items.title: Shores
items.synopsis: Amina’s life revolves around caring for her aging parents and tending to their family home. A surprise visit from her cousin, Azam, brings back memories from 15 years ago. As they catch up on the years lost, they reminisce about her lost love. The unexpected visit gives Amina the closure she never knew she needed, leaving her at peace with her past and more accepting of her present. Years of conflict are resolved through a homecoming and a simple “knock on the door.”

items.title: Damned
items.synopsis: A social-media influencer goes in search of an old, forgotten folk singer Naseem Bano, whose claim to fame was an off-hand compliment from Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan in 1988. He wants her to sing for his Instagram feed but she has forgotten herself. Late at night, when the whole hospital sleeps, she has a flash of memory.

items.title: Neighbours of the Beast
items.synopsis: Following the triumphant return of the tigers, the natives develop a deep connection with their forest.

items.title: Distance
items.synopsis: Ambika drives her late best friend’s 13-year-old son, Dhruv, back to boarding school after his father’s sudden death. The ride is strained by Dhruv’s unexplained animosity, which worsens when Ambika’s careless driving breaks his prized windmill science project. The journey culminates when Dhruv confronts her with a painful shared secret.

items.title: Heartbeat
items.synopsis: In Mumbai’s Bhavani Nagar slum, domestic worker Vimal and her daughter Sonali reflect on education and ambition. Vimal never attended school and hoped Sonali would secure an office job, but Sonali was diagnosed as a “slow learner.” The film portrays their bond with work, learning, and each other.

items.title: The Blood Countess
items.synopsis: The Blood Countess and her maid embark on a quest for the red elixir of life and a book that threatens the vampire realm. Hot on their heels are a police inspector, two vampirologists, a vegetarian nephew and his therapist.

items.title: Balaraw: Blood Island
items.synopsis: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

items.title: Wild Horse Nine
items.synopsis: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

items.title: The Mosquito Bowl
items.synopsis: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

items.title: Marina i Futa
items.synopsis:
"Marina and Futa" follows the rise of two young artists seeking their place in the music scene of the era, charting their journey to becoming one of the most renowned songwriting duos in the former Yugoslavia.

While crafting hits for the biggest stars of the time, Marina and Futa navigate personal challenges, crucial life decisions, and changes that shape their family. Their relationship, life together, and creative work are portrayed through a story of inspiring love, a family that provides strength, and music that lives on across generations.

items.title: Your Dearest, Darkest Friend with Ted Raimi
items.original_title: Your Dearest, Darkest Friend with Ted Raimi
items.synopsis: The darkly whimsical Ted Raimi and his spooky puppet pals welcome celebrity guests into their haunted manor for an evening of thrilling conversation and spine-tingling cocktails, with a twist only Ted can execute.

items.title: Learning with Pibby: Armageddon
items.synopsis: A preschool cartoon character is stranded in corrupted worlds, deciding to save the universe as a hero or risk the Darkness consuming them first.

items.title: Meethe Mein Kya Hai
items.synopsis: A young widower's grief eases at a joyful Diwali reunion — until his sister's surprise marriage throws the family into chaos.

items.title: Dead-End Job
items.synopsis: When a debtor is lured by a strange agency with the promise of lucrative gigs, he is soon thrust into a hellish world of terror and unpredictability.

items.title: The Perfect Lie
items.synopsis: After a heart-fluttering date, Joonho, a heart surgeon with a perfect smile, and Jisun, a free-spirited teacher-librarian, share a special night. The next day, they meet at a police station with completely different memories. A shocking polygraph result turns their lives upside down.

items.title: Akka
items.synopsis: Set in the 1980s matriarchal society of a fictional city of Pernuru, South India, women reign supreme and power has a new name - Akka! Akka is the tale of gangster queens whose matriarchal rule is challenged when an outsider brings an unseen threat, spiralling the all-powerful sisterhood into a chaos storm of violence and survival.

items.title: 5 mins to vomit
items.synopsis: 5 mins to vomit is a show about disgusting and wierd stuff in one anthology horror skit show in 5 mins.

items.title: Resistance to the Daleks, Part One
items.original_title: Resistance to the Daleks, Part One
items.synopsis:
The Daleks have conquered Skaro. But the resistance has begun.

Ten years after Genesis of the Daleks, scattered bands of Thal resistance fighters wage a desperate guerrilla war against their new Dalek masters. When the Doctor and Sarah Jane arrive on Skaro, they find themselves drawn into a battle that could determine the future of the planet.

RESISTANCE TO THE DALEKS — PART ONE

Coming this fall.

A fan-made Doctor Who production created as a tribute to the classic 1970s era of the series.

DISCLAIMER: Unofficial fan production. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the BBC.

items.title: Earworm
items.synopsis: Austin is a grieving young man who can't keep himself from revisiting the room where his ex-boyfriend murdered another former partner. Meanwhile he finds himself in a co-dependent dynamic with Eve, a non-confrontational, quietly misanthropic student who now lives in the very same room.

items.title: Baddies USA: Chapter 3
items.synopsis: The next chapter of Baddies USA continues with new music, new faces, and a whole lot of new drama.

items.title: Desperately Devoted
items.synopsis: Teri Hatcher reunites with her former on-screen daughter Andrea Bowen and her real-life daughter Emerson Tenney to revisit Desperate Housewives, reflecting on its most memorable storylines, characters and behind-the-scenes moments.

items.title: Bass X Machina
items.synopsis: In a lawless Steampunk West overrun by brutal outlaws, machines, and supernatural terrors, a father is forced to become judge, jury, and executioner—knowing that every act of justice meant to protect his family may ultimately cost him the very people he's fighting to save.

items.title: Paige Prater
items.synopsis: Paige, Poppy, and Petra are 3 sisters who have three signature colors: pink, purple, and yellow. As they rule together, they'll do anything to make their dreams some true!

items.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
items.synopsis: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.

items.title: Ghost Soldier
items.synopsis: Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald has spent years living quietly off the grid, hiding from a past few people know anything about. But when a powerful foreign corporation moves into his hometown to seize his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz is forced to reveal who he really is: a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

items.title: The Cat in the Hat
items.synopsis: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

items.title: Club Kid
items.synopsis: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

items.title: The Greatest
items.synopsis: An intimate exploration of the incomparable life of Muhammad Ali. The amazing victories and defeats that made Ali a legend, both in and out of the ring, have been well documented and while those landmark events will live in The Greatest, the heartbeat of the story is fueled by all the moments that took place outside of the spotlight. The world remembers an icon, but The Greatest is about a man, a husband, a father, a brother, and a son.

items.title: Taken: Natalee Holloway
items.synopsis: Beth Holloway, Natalee's mother, tells the full, definitive story of the case that's haunted her for the past 20 years - from the day of Natalee's disappearance to the dramatic confession two decades later.

items.title: MP3
items.synopsis: Welcome to the world of 'MP3' — a satirical music video countdown show from Dropout featuring three new absurd music videos each episode. Join hosts Dane Cartel (Jeremy Culhane), Dr. Muse-Tina, (Skye Townsend), and Chia (Aparna Nancherla) as they interview wild guests, get into spats with producer Thomas Cartel (Paul F. Tompkins), and introduce new music videos performed by Dropout comedians such as Lou Wilson, Lily Du, Katie Marovitch and more.

items.title: The Remarried Empress
items.synopsis: Beloved Empress Navier rules the Eastern Empire alongside Emperor Sovieshu. But when Sovieshu falls for a runaway slave and demands a divorce, Navier will agree on one condition: that she's given approval to remarry rival Prince Heinrey of the Western Kingdom.

items.title: The Body in the Locker
items.synopsis: When Amy, the CEO of a major charity, loses her father, she's shocked to discover he owned a mysterious storage locker with a deadly secret inside - the body of a woman. Was her father a murderer? Who was this woman?

items.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
items.synopsis: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

items.title: I Play Rocky
items.synopsis: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

items.title: Being Heumann
items.synopsis: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

items.title: Drummer Boy
items.synopsis: As America’s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family each search for freedom in a world built to deny it. With music carrying hope through battle and loss, Drummer Boy turns the Revolution into a deeply human story of faith, forgiveness, and the belief that no person is born to live in chains or be forgotten.

items.title: Lakadbaggha 2: The Monkey Business
items.synopsis: Sequel to Lakadbaggha (2023). Plot TBA.

items.title: The Torch
items.synopsis: Meira foregrounds the historic and continuing resistance of the Meira Paibi, “women with torches” of Manipur. Emerging in response to the pervasive climate of fear produced by the enforcement of the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act, 1958, the film traces how ordinary women transformed themselves into vigilant custodians of their communities. Meira situates the movement within a longer genealogy of women-led resistance in Manipur.

items.title: The Girl Beneath The Sun
items.synopsis: Teenage sugarcane harvester Shivkanya confronts the realities of early motherhood and marriage, unspoken duties, an eccentric  husband and an uncertain future that shapes and  constrains her dreams, identity and hopes for her child and herself.

items.title: RAMAYAN AN ATHARV SRIVASTAVA SERIES
items.synopsis: An epic 4K animated retelling of the timeless legend of righteousness, devotion, and valor, produced by Bhakti Tales Productions.

items.title: Campus Drivers
items.synopsis: Lois has everything going for her: she's been accepted into the prestigious Belrose University alongside her lifelong love, Max. Lane, on the other hand, lives by his own rules. Creator of Campus Drivers, the hottest app on campus, he is as famous for his devastating smile as for his inability to commit. Their paths were never supposed to cross. Until the night when Lois, heartbroken, shows up on his doorstep. An unexpected cohabitation. Two worlds colliding. And an attraction impossible to ignore. But some encounters change everything… even awakening buried wounds. And when love arrives uninvited, nothing is certain anymore.

items.title: Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook
items.synopsis: Hollywood actor and comedian Nora Lum (a.k.a. Awkwafina) is the descendant of restaurant royalty...but she can't cook. Join the star on an inspiring culinary road trip as she learns the craft and attempts to revive her family's beloved Chinese eatery.

items.title: Doozie's Doghouse
items.synopsis: Doozie is pinching into her very own Doghouse for some puppy-riffic adventures with her best pup Puggie and all her Doozie Dogs. From the creators of DreamWorks Animation's hit series Gabby's Dollhouse, Doozie's Doghouse is a mixed-media companion series that continues the fun with tail-wagging surprises, woof-tastic unboxings, and imaginative play. Creativity is limitless in Doozie's Doghouse!

items.title: First, Do No Harm
items.synopsis: Christian Polish gynecologist Alicja is visited by her old friend asking her to terminate her pregnancy. She has to make a difficult decision if she is going to obey her faith and laws or help her friend.

items.title: Catch Us
items.synopsis: Steven Gätjen serves as the Gamemaster; broadcasting from his Cologne studio, he sends the celebrities fleeing to a pre-selected major European city on October 17—giving them a one-hour head start. From that point on, their goal is to avoid being caught by the "Hunters" and their community for five days. Meanwhile, Kiwi, Jenke, and Chris Tall must complete tasks that lure them out of hiding and into the public eye. Throughout the hunt, they also wear distinctive red-and-white striped shirts.

items.title: Ebenezer
items.synopsis: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

items.title: Madden
items.synopsis: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

items.title: How to Rob a Bank
items.synopsis: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

items.title: Victorian Psycho
items.synopsis: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

items.title: The Body
items.synopsis: After a dance-team initiation gone wrong, a group of badly behaved Catholic school girls begin having prophetic visions that set off mass hysteria in their town.

items.title: Separated at Birth
items.synopsis: Paramedics Sameer and Donna thrive under pressure but fail at adulting. When Sameer's wife leaves after their son's birth, and Donna's new house becomes a money pit - can these two repair the mess they've made of their lives?

items.title: Hurt
items.synopsis: The town is Reddington, there’s nothing much left of the place. With Mayor Mason and his crime and corruption soaking up what’s left, a young man named William could be the only one to change it, that’s until everything he has is taken away from him. Out for revenge and redemption, he won’t stop until he’s finished with the people who wronged him.

items.title: What a Boss Wants
items.synopsis: A struggling CEO's only hope to turn his career around lies in an indie singer – but neither of them expected to fall for each other.

items.title: Under Fire
items.synopsis: As a fire captain in Idaho, Rob has spent his life saving others. Now, with the help of an experimental therapy, he may just learn how to save himself.

A heist takes 12 months to plan, 12 hours to execute—and a thief not caught within 12 days won't be caught at all. Across three pulse-pounding timelines, an FBI agent and a career criminal face off in a deadly game of cat and mouse through Europe.

items.title: The Good Daughter
items.synopsis: Sisters Charlotte and Samantha Quinn have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence. When another attack splinters the small town of Pikeville, Charlotte is the first witness on the scene. Now a lawyer like her father, she’s forced to confront her own demons as the case twists through one shocking revelation after another. In the end, both she and Samantha find themselves wondering if the price of being the good daughter was worth it after all.

items.title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
items.original_title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
items.synopsis: A new group of dynamic young mothers in Orange County collide in a community where beliefs are not just their religion; they are their identity. While some defend their way of life, fighting against modernity, others embrace change, becoming a platform to disrupt the status quo. Scandals and secrets will be revealed, facades will crumble, and families and friendships will change forever on both sides of the battlefield as this group of strong, game-changing influencers comes together to build their answer to #MomTok.

items.title: Omerta
items.synopsis: The series delves into the life of the prominent and influential Van Loo family, where behind their perfect image and luxurious lifestyle lies a web of secrets that must remain hidden at all costs.

items.title: Paper Tiger
items.synopsis: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

items.title: Nakhrewaalii
items.synopsis: Upcoming Hindi film.

items.title: Student of the Year: After Dark
items.original_title: Student of the Year: After Dark
items.synopsis: Student of the Year 3

items.title: Eurovision Song Contest Asia
items.synopsis:
The world's most iconic music competition is coming to Asia, and it's about to get louder, bolder and bigger than ever.

From national selection shows across Asia to a live Grand Final in Bangkok, packed with lights, sound and unstoppable energy — this is where the region comes together.

items.title: Sword & Silence
items.synopsis: A sweeping historical epic set in the late Three Kingdoms era, following Silla’s fierce battles against Goguryeo, Baekje, and Tang as its kings and generals fight to achieve the unification of the Korean Peninsula.

items.title: Kidney
items.synopsis: In a remote village, two rival families – one privileged Hindu, the other a struggling Muslim family – are trapped in an endless cycle of feuds. A young man dreaming of TikTok fame and a woman yearning to escape patriarchy fall in love. When an inheritance dispute erupts, their relationship is caught between greed, betrayal, and a conflict that threatens to turn blood against blood.

items.title: Crime and Punishment in America
items.synopsis: Explores the history of criminal justice in America — from the pre-colonial period to 21st century mass incarceration.

items.title: Aroma
items.synopsis: Yang, a nurse with an unusually selective sense of smell, can tolerate only disinfectant and lemon—until she encounters the scent of Fang, a man in a vegetative state. As she imagines her way into his memories, guilt and forbidden desires, the boundaries between intimacy, projection and death begin to dissolve. Moving between waking life and dream, Aroma is a dark contemporary fairy tale about the body, desire, and love that refuses to disappear when the body does.

items.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
items.original_title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
items.synopsis: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

items.title: Guarding Stars
items.synopsis: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

items.title: V. Shantaram
items.synopsis: Chronicles Shantaram Rajaram Vankudre, aka V. Shantaram, on his remarkable journey from the silent era through the advent of sound and colour, showcasing his evolution as one of India’s most influential filmmakers.

items.title: Princess
items.synopsis: Twelve-year-old Kallpa has one big dream: to be chosen as Ñusta, the sacred princess in her Andean community's Winter Solstice Festival. However, she is barred from taking part because she was born in the body of a boy. As rigid traditions and growing rejection push her out, Kallpa finds a new home and family among a group of local trans women. Even while facing harsh prejudice, this close-knit group wraps Kallpa in real warmth and tenderness, giving her the room to figure out who she is and learn to love herself. Her journey becomes a quiet, resilient fight to live life on her own terms.

items.title: The Altruists
items.synopsis: The story of Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison, two hyper-smart, ambitious young idealists who tried to remake the global financial system in the blink of an eye - before they were accused of stealing $8 billion and became Gen Z's own Bonnie & Clyde.

items.title: The Assignment
items.synopsis: The summer of 1947. Although it is already the second year of peace following the devastating Second World War, its deep wounds are still everywhere. Thirteen-year-old Ewout, is also recovering from the conflict. He is just a boy, but he wants to be a man of distinction. He joins the scouts to prove himself. Unfortunately, things do not go to plan, and the others turn against him.

items.title: Steps
items.synopsis: Think you know Cinderella's 'evil' stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

items.title: Josephine
items.synopsis: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

items.title: November 1963
items.synopsis: Follows the 48 hours after the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, the alleged involvement of Sam Giancana and the 'Chicago Outfit', and a supposed broken promise after the mob helped to get Kennedy elected.

items.title: Kaali Kheti
items.synopsis: Plot TBA; set against a rural backdrop and explores a world where family, legacy and buried truths come together to create an unsettling tale of fear.

items.title: Elsinore
items.synopsis: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

items.title: AndherPura Curse
items.synopsis: AndherPura Curse Is A Minecraft Series Presented By SmilyBag.

items.title: Supreme Solaris
items.synopsis:
Seventeen-year-old Veer Singh's life changes forever when an extraordinary alien device known as Xion bonds with his chest, awakening powers beyond human comprehension. As the ancient cosmic intelligence within Xion guides him through a dangerous journey of discovery and training, Veer must learn to control his newfound abilities and confront the responsibility that comes with them.

But becoming a hero demands more than extraordinary power. Faced with fear, difficult choices, and threats that extend far beyond Earth, Veer must discover what it truly means to become Supreme Solaris—the one who stands as a beacon of hope when darkness threatens humanity.

items.title: Dig
items.synopsis: Follow four women who work at an archeological dig in Greece. When the team uncovers a long-buried secret with the potential to rewrite history, they find themselves at the center of a high-stakes international conspiracy.

items.title: New Wave
items.synopsis: This series tells the fascinating story of New Wave music and the decade from 1977 to 1987 that brought alternative culture into the mainstream. The four-part series will take us on a journey through the rise of New Wave from its rebellious origins to its influential impact on music, fashion, and pop culture. New Wave defined a generation and reshaped the musical landscape in part by embracing women, the queer community and new technology while in the process creating a legacy that is still influencing us today.

items.title: Hexed
items.synopsis: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

items.title: Focker-in-Law
items.synopsis: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

items.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
items.original_title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
items.synopsis: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

items.title: Blade Runner 2099
items.synopsis: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

items.title: From Inside Out: The Architecture of Peter Zumthor
items.original_title: From Inside Out - Die Architektur von Peter Zumthor
items.synopsis: We all come from houses in which we live, dream, love and die. This long-term documentary project explores the significance of architecture in our everyday lives and takes its audience on a journey to the most impressive places designed by Swiss architect Peter Zumthor.

items.title: Fool Night
items.synopsis: In a dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of transforming into a Spirit Flower — a plant into which humans transform. Should he continue living as a person, or discard his pain and start a new life as a plant? Which path would you choose in his situation?

items.title: Munawwara Ka Khadim
items.synopsis: Munawwara Ka Khadim is an upcoming Pakistani television drama series on HUM TV that stars the popular on-screen reunion of Hamza Sohail and Sehar Khan.

items.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
items.synopsis: A heartfelt romantic family drama about two best friends whose close bond slowly turns into love. But one lie creates misunderstandings and conflicts, putting their relationship and family bonds to the test. The story explores love, sacrifice, understanding and the importance of family.

items.title: Gunmaaster G9
items.synopsis: A man in love takes extreme measures to be with the woman he desires, facing off against a dangerous adversary.

items.title: Diler
items.synopsis: A Maddock Film

items.title: Cunk on Cinema
items.synopsis: Philomena will be asking experts all of the hard-hitting questions about the history of cinema, from the invention of the camera, to the New Wave filmmakers of the 60s, right up to entrance of CGI and what the future of AI holds. Cunk will attempt to demystify it all while sitting in lumpy seats with stale popcorn, asking herself where did cinema come from? And why? What does it want? And why can't it tell us?

items.title: Violent Night 2
items.synopsis: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

items.title: Behemoth!
items.synopsis: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

items.title: Ray Gunn
items.synopsis: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

items.title: The Man with the Bag
items.synopsis: After Santa’s magic bag is stolen, he turns to his naughty list to find Vance, a thief, to help him get it back. Along with his daughter, Santa, and a group of misfits, Vance will have to pull off the greatest heist of his life to save Christmas.

items.title: Pride and Prejudice
items.synopsis: Elizabeth Bennet is an unmarried woman and the second of five daughters of Mr. and Mrs. Bennet from Hertfordshire, near London. The Bennet home can only be inherited by males in the family, so the pressure is on for the daughters to marry well or risk losing everything. While out in society, Elizabeth interacts with single men like Mr. Darcy, an outwardly curmudgeon who is misunderstood.

items.title: Bokshi
items.synopsis: Anahita, traumatised by the brutal disappearance of her mother, finds comfort in Shalini, her history teacher. On an unconventional school excursion to a mysterious prehistoric site, she confronts her terrifying destiny.

items.title: Cousin Isha
items.synopsis: After being publicly humiliated and heartbroken when his lover marries someone else, Ajit, the son of a small-town sweet shop owner, hits rock bottom-until Isha, his bold and fashionable distant cousin, unexpectedly enters his life, turning his pain into a potential new beginning.

items.title: Eetha
items.synopsis: Vithabai Narayangaonkar, a renowned Marathi Tamasha and Lavani performer rises from humble beginnings to become one of Maharashtra's most celebrated folk theatre artists.

items.title: Last Stay at Hotel Safestay
items.synopsis: This world is not made for fairy-tale adventures. Viri, a 12-year-old, realises this as she embarks on a solo stroll during a vacation with her family.

items.title: Sacred Jewel
items.synopsis: Set during the final years of the Mongol invasions of Korea, the story follows a group risking everything to recover and protect the sacred Avalokitesvara Jewel on a perilous mission across the Goryeo Dynasty. As war rages, Commander Baek-gyeol, Princess Wang-hee, and their companions must navigate love, sacrifice, and political turmoil in a fight for their nation's future.

items.title: Sunshine Girls
items.synopsis: Olivia’s parents’ separation plants her as the new girl at Valley High, where she meets horse girl Taylor and influencer Riley. Freshman year for the unlikely trio of best friends is full of family drama, false starts and first kisses as they each have their time in the sun.

items.title: Batman: Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest
items.synopsis: Batman lies broken at the hands of the villainous mastermind Bane. With Bruce Wayne paralyzed from the waist down and unable to continue as Batman, a new successor must be chosen to defend Gotham City. Jean-Paul Valley, the man also known as Azrael, must take up the mantle of the Batman. But will his more violent methods be enough to stop Bane?

items.title: Narayan Pustika 2 - Endless
items.synopsis: This movie is the second part of the Narayana Pustika trilogy. In which there is a description of the troubles arising from the opening of the unimaginable door revealed by the great sages.

items.title: Witching Hour
items.synopsis: Anaya awakes in the middle of the night and is entranced by the glow of the television screen.

items.title: The Debut
items.synopsis: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

items.title: Ink
items.synopsis: A group of misfits and visionaries had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.

items.title: The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey
items.synopsis: The series centers on one of the most infamous unsolved murder cases in American history, and the devastating personal and public reckoning that followed the death of JonBenet Ramsey on Christmas night in 1996.

items.title: Talk Money
items.synopsis: FINALLY, the raw, transparent conversations you wish you heard about money growing up. Find out what happens before the Grammys, Emmy, awards, elevation, recognition and success. Tune in to see how these exceptional guests transformed their passion into profit.

items.title: Songs of the Djinns
items.synopsis: Two actresses wander the streets of Varanasi on New Year's Eve. Meanwhile, the Goan heroes are preparing a musical event featuring pop stars. One day, they'll find themselves on a ship, where they'll take turns telling their stories. The ship will sail along a quiet river, and on the shore, everyone will be listening: bats in ruined palaces, wandering magicians, and touring DJs. They need to hear the singing of the genies.

items.title: Zero A.D: The Birth of Christ
items.original_title: Zero A.D: The Birth of Christ
items.synopsis: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

items.title: Sakhiya Ho
items.synopsis: Sakhiya Ho is nepali culture song

items.title: Clarissa
items.synopsis: Across a single day in Lagos, Nigeria, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus, a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As the perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois class and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges.

items.title: Tantara
items.synopsis: A period drama depicting the birth of the Korean entertainment industry, and its growth from the Korean War to the 1980s.

items.title: Visceral
items.synopsis: A group of friends goes through a crisis when one of them is accused of sexual abuse on social media.

items.title: Dune: Part Three
items.synopsis: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

items.title: Avengers: Doomsday
items.synopsis: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

items.title: Unaccustomed Earth
items.synopsis: When a health crisis forces a devoted mother and her family to return to the US, she confronts buried desires that upend her Indian American community.

items.title: TED: The Animated Series
items.synopsis: Picking up twelve years after the conclusion of the last movie, John and his thunder-buddy Ted are neighbors, both with families of their own and dead-end jobs. Follow these two lovable stoners as they enable each other's bad ideas about marriage, parenting and the challenges of adult life.

items.title: Quiztopia
items.synopsis: In an alternate Japan, a charismatic host runs a deadly quiz where winners get any wish and losers pay dearly. His world unravels when rebels target him.

items.title: Frisco King
items.synopsis: New Orleans gangster Russell Lee Washington Jr. lands in Frisco, Texas, where he transforms small hustles into big business, with the help of an ambitious protégé, a loyal driver, and a growing network of eccentric partners.

items.title: Jumanji: Open World
items.synopsis: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us - as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

items.title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
items.synopsis: Red faces his greatest challenge yet - surviving fatherhood - while saving the world.

items.title: Kumaari
items.synopsis: An upcoming thriller.

items.title: King
items.synopsis: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

items.title: The Alfred Eulogy
items.synopsis: Following the death of his friend Alfred, Ryan prepares to deliver a eulogy. What begins as an attempt to remember the dead gradually becomes a deeply personal confrontation with grief, guilt, resentment, loneliness, and everything left unsaid between two people.  As Ryan’s memories begin to fracture and contradict one another, the distinction between remembrance and reality slowly dissolves. The Alfred Eulogy is an intimate exploration of grief, masculinity, emotional repression, and the weight of words that were never spoken.

items.title: Werwulf
items.synopsis: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

items.title: Mr. Irrelevant
items.synopsis: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle, defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

items.title: Artificial
items.synopsis: When computer scientist Ilya Sutskever and AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton make a breakthrough they're certain will alter humanity forever, the most prominent figures in Silicon Valley race to become a part of their vision. Years later, after a chance meeting with Sam Altman, Sutskever and a group of idealistic entrepreneurs create OpenAI with backing from Elon Musk and assistance from engineer Mira Murati.

items.title: Harry Potter
items.synopsis: There is nothing special about Harry Potter - at least that's what his Aunt Petunia always says. On his 11th birthday, a letter of admittance to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry opens up a hidden world for Harry: one of fun, friendship and magic. But with this new adventure comes great risk as Harry is forced to face a dangerous enemy from his past.

items.title: Clara and the Below
items.synopsis: To save her bedridden ex-military father, Clara must fight the spirits of the soldiers he killed on the battlefield in a surreal world known simply as the Below. She is aided by a mischievous toy nutcracker, her only guide in a place where the ghosts of the past run rampant.

items.title: Chiranjeevi Hanuman: The Eternal
items.synopsis: An AI-generated film about the Hindu god Hanuman; it will draw from the sacred texts of Indian epic 'Ramayana' and Puranic literature to create what producers describe as an “awe-inspiring, visual odyssey designed to be enjoyed as a shared experience in theaters.”

items.title: Teen Kauwe
items.synopsis: An Out and Out Comedy

items.title: Seeing is Believing: The Story of Narrative Art
items.original_title: Seeing is Believing: The Story of Narrative Art
items.synopsis: A documentary series commissioned for the Lucas Museum, Seeing is Believing: The Story of Narrative Art explores the collective human desire to tell stories through images.

items.title: My Little Pony: Forever Friendship
items.synopsis: The series is said to follow “Twilight Sparkle, Pinkie Pie, Rainbow Dash, and Fluttershy as they embark on a new journey of friendship, magic and self-discovery.”

items.title: Legends
items.synopsis: Follows the cast of "Sons of Anarchy" as they reunite at a fan convention after more than a decade, where the line between life and art blurs and the fractured brotherhood faces a real-world threat.

items.title: Lumine
items.synopsis: Follows Lumine, a down-on-his-luck weredog who meets antisocial witch boy Kody and stumbles into a family full of secrets in a world where weredogs, witches, and humans coexist.

items.title: Aaj
items.synopsis: The series Aaj officially and independently explores the case of Mohammad Bijeh and the crimes that took place in Pakdasht. Blending documentary and drama, the series features actors alongside reenactments of some of the events.

items.title: Mouthwashing : The Film
items.synopsis: The Indian Film Adaptation Of The Bone-Chilling Video Game - Mouthwashing

items.title: The Rookie: North
items.synopsis: After a violent home invasion ignites a dormant purpose, Alex Holland battles a lifetime of failed commitments by joining the Pierce County Police Department as a rookie. Policing from the urban coast to the rural forest where backup isn't just five minutes away, Alex must prove to his skeptical training officer, his fellow rookies and himself that he's finally found something worthy of the fight.

items.title: Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san?
items.original_title: 地雷なんですか？地原さん
items.synopsis:
It's the start of a new semester, and high school junior Kuroki finds himself seated beside the girl everyone whispers about: Mai Chihara. With her gothic fashion, jet-black hair, and intense stare, Chihara is said to be a “landmine” girl or jirai-kei, the hyper-feminine, dark aesthetic often associated with yandere tendencies and unstable personalities. But when Kuroki accidentally draws Chihara's attention, he discovers she isn't nearly as unstable as people claim. Beneath the intimidating aura is a surprisingly sweet girl… if a little weird.

Hesitantly, Kuroki begins to learn more about Chihara and her strange quirks. Is there more to her than her volatile reputation? Or is all the dark clothing just a red flag in disguise?

items.title: Golmaal 5
items.synopsis: Get ready for another rollercoaster of laughter with the iconic gang.

items.title: The Beekeeper 2
items.synopsis: Pulled back into the fight when the Beekeeper organization goes rogue and sets its sights on controlling the government, Clay must take on the very group that made him.

items.title: Children of Blood and Bone
items.synopsis: In the world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule.

items.title: River
items.synopsis: After being stranded in a boat on a country river, three siblings are stalked by a faceless killer.

items.title: Bloodaxe
items.synopsis: Follow Erik Bloodaxe, and his formidable wife, Gunnhild, Mother of Kings as they fight for the throne of Norway, the land is torn apart by fierce rivals, shifting loyalties, and bloody betrayals. With war looming and chaos consuming the kingdom, drawing in the ruthless Kings of other Scandinavian countries, and even a powerful English ruler, the stage is set for a thundering, cataclysmic, compelling and utterly magical new Viking Saga.

items.title: Neuromancer
items.synopsis: A disgraced superhacker and a razorgirl assassin are recruited for a high-stakes heist targeting a powerful corporate dynasty with untold wealth...and secrets they'd kill to protect.

items.title: Love & War
items.synopsis: Two strong-willed Army officers find their lives intertwined with a woman, forming a complicated love triangle.

items.title: Ice Age: Boiling Point
items.synopsis: A dinosaur-and-lava-filled madcap adventure takes Manny, Sid, Diego, Ellie, Buck, acorn-obsessed Scrat – this time joined by Baby Scrat and the enormous Jurassic Scrat – and the rest of the herd to visit never before-seen corners of the treacherous Lost World.

items.title: Reverse Myself
items.synopsis: A man who drowns in a pond and becomes trapped in another dimension attempts to recover a device stolen by his evil vibrance and restore his erased memories—driven by a single goal: to find his way back home.

items.title: Remain
items.synopsis: When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

items.title: CoComelon: The Movie
items.synopsis: JJ embarks on the biggest adventure of his life: Kindergarten. But when, on his first day at school, JJ discovers that his beloved stuffed bear Boba has gone missing, JJ and his friends Cody, CeCe and Nina will begin a quest that will transport them into a magical land ruled by Princess Harmony, who has created a world with one rule: No singing.

items.title: LEGO Ninjago: Dragons' Fury
items.synopsis: Reeling from the loss of Lloyd, the Ninja face their evil counterparts. When signs of his survival offer new hope, the team embarks on a dangerous search for answers. Meanwhile, Ras gathers ancient artifacts for a plan that threatens the Merged Lands, forcing the Ninja to confront their grief, trust new leaders, and uncover secrets that could change their world forever.

items.title: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
items.synopsis: Two children discover a wood full of pools leading to other worlds. One takes them to a dead city beneath a dying sun, where they wake a queen who exterminated its population and accidentally bring her back to London.

items.title: Barbershop
items.synopsis: Travis 'Trav' Porter endeavors to follow in the footsteps of his grandfather, a legendary barber at the Calvin's barbershop in Chicago. And while the barbers are new, the shop remains just as lively, the customers just as argumentative, and the fades are still the dopest in the city.

items.title: Trimmed
items.synopsis: An American dancer arrives in Berlin to audition for a renowned dance company, only to enter a strange world of rules and unspoken boundaries.

items.title: Father Joe
items.synopsis: Set in 1990s Manhattan, the film will see Sutherland play a priest who declares a one-man war on the city’s criminal underworld. Pacino steps into the role of a powerful mob boss whose empire collides with Father Joe’s violent crusade, while Anderson plays a young woman caught between danger and redemption under the priest’s protection.

items.title: Naagzilla
items.synopsis: In a world where shape-shifting Ichhadhaari naags have been living amongst humans, chaos ensues when a once carefree Ichhadhaari naag's Naagmani and his life are threatened by a wily, power- hungry villain.

items.title: The Land
items.synopsis: The story of two families, in which the high-stakes drama plays out not only on the field but also in the front offices of this NFL franchise, as a loyal fanbase wants a winning season now ... or face big changes if they don't.

items.title: Oswald
items.synopsis: When an earthquake releases Walt Disney's creation, Oswald, who has been hidden away since the 1920s, a middle school boy and his friends try to help the cartoon rabbit navigate his way through the modern world.

items.title: Andhar
items.synopsis: In an isolated house where flowers wilt at a touch and time refuses to move in a straight line, a fragile young widow begins a new life, with a much older husband, she can't quite trust - haunted by warnings, watched by something patient, and carrying a secret that isn't only her own. When an impossible death draws a sharp-witted detective into the house's orbit, he finds a place that bends memory, guards an ancient purpose, and refuses to let anyone leave unchanged. What waits beneath is older than the walls, and the answer, when it comes at dawn, will reach further than anyone expects.
